messages:
Ivy (PM): Quick sync: sales reported two enterprise asks — strict EU residency and APAC latency guarantees. Need a compact plan and launch gates.
Priya (Arch): Recommend two-stage: 1) policy-driven affinity + templates (fast), 2) reservation lanes + admission controller (later).
Rafi (Eng): Soft-affinity: implement policy flags + dry-run placement. Hard residency: needs reservations, quota accounting, billing changes. Soft path is low-effort.
Noah (SRE): Ops concerns: hard reservations reduce placement flexibility and increase failover risk. Require evacuation playbook and reservation saturation alarms.
Ellen (Sales): Customers want clear names. I'll offer "Residency Preview" for soft-affinity pilots and avoid no-egress wording until Legal signs off.
Zoe (Legal): Pilot contracts must state fallback ordering and that absolute no-egress requires attestation (KMS in-region + audit logs).
Ivy (PM): Proposed roadmap: Q1: templates, simulator, telemetry, two pilots. Q2: soft-affinity GA + pilot feedback. Q3: reservation pilot + migration tooling.
Priya (Arch): Telemetry gating: percent_served_in_preferred_region >= 90% for pilot tenants, fallback_rate < 1% during canary, cache_cross-region_miss delta < 15%.
Rafi (Eng): API sketch: route_policy { tenant: "T-900" template: "residency-soft" prefer_region: "eu-west-1" dry_run: true } Dry-run returns placement prediction and warnings.
Noah (SRE): Ops acceptance for canary: 48h ramp, <3 P0s, automated rollback on >20% cross-region latency degradation. Schedule tabletop before pilot.
Ellen (Sales): I'll recruit two pilot customers (EU, APAC) and draft non-binding pilot terms. Price later based on simulator numbers.
Zoe (Legal): I'll review pilot terms and ensure fallback SLAs and opt-in for emergency cross-region failover.
Ivy (PM): Action items: Rafi  spike + dry-run API (1 week). Priya  templates + telemetry spec (5 days). Noah  ops runbook + chaos plan (10 days). Ellen  pilot signups (1 week). Zoe  legal review (3 days). ops-bot: Reminder: link roadmap PR to #release-war-room by EOD Fri.
Ivy (PM): Thanks all  reconvene after spikes to lock dates.
